reason: I've never paid for a creator tool and I'm not starting now. Collab DMs already come in every week, and a free first counted collab is enough for me to test it. I'd use the free part and skip the pass.
objection: Why pay ₹499 a year when barter deals come to my DMs anyway? And I'm not sure a café owner will bother counting coupons at the counter. If they don't, the 'customers I brought' record is empty and the pass does nothing for me.
would_change_my_mind: Proof that a brand actually paid a creator cash because of their Mitra count record. Or earning the pass free by bringing cafés, so I never pay.
